newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Volatile Chicago keeps lid on European feeds trade.
newsitem.headline: Volatile Chicago keeps lid on European feeds trade.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained slow this afternoon as a heavily fluctuating Chicago futures market and a strong dollar discouraged both buyers and sellers from entering the market, dealers said.
"In these kind of markets you have the feeling that whatever you do turns out to be wrong, so most people sit back and do nothing at all," one dealer said.
A few trades were reported late on the back of Safras revising Brazilian 1996/97 soymeal production downwards at 26.22 from 26.88, which could push the market up.
